def graphBilinear {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (p q : α → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ a,∑ b,if R a b then p a*q b else 0

def graphEdgeMass {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (w : α → ℝ) : ℝ := graphBilinear R w w

def graphNeighborMass {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (w : α → ℝ) (a : α) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ b,if R a b then w b else 0

def mergeDirection {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (x y : α) : α → ℝ := fun a => (if a=x then 1 else 0)-(if a=y then 1 else 0)

theorem graphBilinear_add_left {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (p q r : α → ℝ) :
    graphBilinear R (p+q) r=graphBilinear R p r+graphBilinear R q r := by
  classical
  simp only [graphBilinear,Pi.add_apply,add_mul,ite_add_zero,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem graphBilinear_smul_left {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (t : ℝ) (p q : α → ℝ) :
    graphBilinear R (t • p) q=t*graphBilinear R p q := by
  classical
  simp only [graphBilinear,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,mul_assoc,mul_ite,mul_zero,Finset.mul_sum]

theorem graphBilinear_symmetric {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop)
    (hR : Symmetric R) (p q : α → ℝ) : graphBilinear R p q=graphBilinear R q p := by
  classical
  rw [graphBilinear,graphBilinear,Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  by_cases hab : R a b
  · simp [hab,hR hab,mul_comm]
  · have hba : ¬R b a := fun h => hab (hR h)
    simp [hab,hba]

theorem graphBilinear_mergeDirection {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (w : α → ℝ) (x y : α) :
    graphBilinear R (mergeDirection x y) w=graphNeighborMass R w x-graphNeighborMass R w y := by
  classical
  have hd (P : Prop) [Decidable P] (u v : ℝ) :
      (if P then u-v else 0)=(if P then u else 0)-(if P then v else 0) := by
    by_cases h : P <;> simp [h]
  simp only [graphBilinear,mergeDirection,sub_mul,ite_mul,one_mul,zero_mul,hd,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have ht (a b z : α) : (if R a b then (if a=z then w b else 0) else 0)=
      (if a=z then (if R a b then w b else 0) else 0) := by
    by_cases h : R a b <;> by_cases hz : a=z <;> simp [h,hz]
  simp_rw [ht]
  simp [graphNeighborMass]


theorem graphBilinear_add_right {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop)
    (hR : Symmetric R) (p q r : α → ℝ) :
    graphBilinear R p (q+r)=graphBilinear R p q+graphBilinear R p r := by
  rw [graphBilinear_symmetric R hR p (q+r),graphBilinear_add_left]
  rw [graphBilinear_symmetric R hR q p,graphBilinear_symmetric R hR r p]

theorem graphBilinear_smul_right {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop)
    (hR : Symmetric R) (t : ℝ) (p q : α → ℝ) :
    graphBilinear R p (t • q)=t*graphBilinear R p q := by
  rw [graphBilinear_symmetric R hR p (t • q),graphBilinear_smul_left,graphBilinear_symmetric R hR q p]

theorem mergeDirection_edge_zero {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (x y : α) (hxy : ¬R x y) : graphBilinear R (mergeDirection x y) (mergeDirection x y)=0 := by
  classical
  have hNeighbor (a : α) (ha : a=x ∨ a=y) : graphNeighborMass R (mergeDirection x y) a=0 := by
    unfold graphNeighborMass
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    by_cases hab : R a b
    · have hbx : b≠x := by
        intro h;subst b
        rcases ha with rfl|rfl
        · exact hIr _ hab
        · exact hxy (hR hab)
      have hby : b≠y := by
        intro h;subst b
        rcases ha with rfl|rfl
        · exact hxy hab
        · exact hIr _ hab
      simp [hab,mergeDirection,hbx,hby]
    · simp [hab]
  rw [graphBilinear_mergeDirection,hNeighbor x (Or.inl rfl),hNeighbor y (Or.inr rfl),sub_self]

theorem graphEdgeMass_merge_formula {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (w : α → ℝ) (x y : α) (hxy : ¬R x y) (t : ℝ) :
    graphEdgeMass R (w+t • mergeDirection x y)=graphEdgeMass R w+
      2*t*(graphNeighborMass R w x-graphNeighborMass R w y) := by
  unfold graphEdgeMass
  simp only [graphBilinear_add_left,graphBilinear_add_right R hR,graphBilinear_smul_left,graphBilinear_smul_right R hR]
  rw [mergeDirection_edge_zero R hR hIr x y hxy,
    graphBilinear_symmetric R hR w (mergeDirection x y),graphBilinear_mergeDirection]
  ring

def mergedWeights {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (w : α → ℝ) (x y : α) : α → ℝ := w+w y • mergeDirection x y

def positiveGraphSupport {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (w : α → ℝ) : Finset α := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun a => 0<w a)

theorem mergedWeights_values {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (w : α → ℝ) (x y : α) (hxy : x≠y) :
    mergedWeights w x y x=w x+w y ∧ mergedWeights w x y y=0 ∧
      ∀ a,a≠x → a≠y → mergedWeights w x y a=w a := by
  refine ⟨by simp [mergedWeights,mergeDirection,hxy],by simp [mergedWeights,mergeDirection,Ne.symm hxy],?_⟩
  intro a hax hay
  simp [mergedWeights,mergeDirection,hax,hay]

theorem mergedWeights_step {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a,0≤w a) (x y : α) (hx : 0<w x) (hy : 0<w y)
    (hxy : x≠y) (hNon : ¬R x y) (hNeighbor : graphNeighborMass R w y≤graphNeighborMass R w x) :
    (∀ a,0≤mergedWeights w x y a) ∧ (∑ a,mergedWeights w x y a)=∑ a,w a ∧
      graphEdgeMass R w≤graphEdgeMass R (mergedWeights w x y) ∧
      positiveGraphSupport (mergedWeights w x y)=(positiveGraphSupport w).erase y := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hMx,hMy,hMo⟩ := mergedWeights_values w x y hxy
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a
    by_cases hax : a=x
    · subst a;rw [hMx];positivity
    · by_cases hay : a=y
      · subst a;rw [hMy]
      · rw [hMo a hax hay];exact hw a
  · change (∑ a : α,(w a+w y*mergeDirection x y a))=(∑ a : α,w a)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hD : (∑ a,mergeDirection x y a)=0 := by simp [mergeDirection,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hD,mul_zero,add_zero]
  · rw [mergedWeights,graphEdgeMass_merge_formula R hR hIr w x y hNon]
    nlinarith
  · ext a
    simp only [positiveGraphSupport,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,Finset.mem_erase]
    by_cases hax : a=x
    · subst a;rw [hMx];simp [hxy,hx,show 0<w x+w y by linarith]
    · by_cases hay : a=y
      · subst a;rw [hMy];simp
      · rw [hMo a hax hay];simp [hay]


def graphMergeStep {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (R : α → α → Prop)
    (w q : α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ x y,0<w x ∧ 0<w y ∧ x≠y ∧ ¬R x y ∧
    graphNeighborMass R w y≤graphNeighborMass R w x ∧ q=mergedWeights w x y

def hasCliqueSupport {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (R : α → α → Prop) (w : α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x∈positiveGraphSupport w,∀ y∈positiveGraphSupport w,x≠y → R x y

theorem graph_merge_reduction {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a,0≤w a) (hNot : ¬hasCliqueSupport R w) :
    ∃ q : α → ℝ,graphMergeStep R w q ∧ (∀ a,0≤q a) ∧
      (∑ a,q a)=∑ a,w a ∧ graphEdgeMass R w≤graphEdgeMass R q ∧
      positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧
      (positiveGraphSupport q).card<(positiveGraphSupport w).card := by
  classical
  unfold hasCliqueSupport at hNot
  push_neg at hNot
  obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hxy,hNon⟩ := hNot
  have hx' : 0<w x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hy' : 0<w y := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  have hDo (a b : α) (ha : 0<w a) (hb : 0<w b) (hab : a≠b)
      (hN : ¬R a b) (hScore : graphNeighborMass R w b≤graphNeighborMass R w a) :
      ∃ q : α → ℝ,graphMergeStep R w q ∧ (∀ a,0≤q a) ∧
        (∑ a,q a)=∑ a,w a ∧ graphEdgeMass R w≤graphEdgeMass R q ∧
        positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧
        (positiveGraphSupport q).card<(positiveGraphSupport w).card := by
    obtain ⟨hPos,hSum,hEdge,hSupp⟩ := mergedWeights_step R hR hIr w hw a b ha hb hab hN hScore
    refine ⟨mergedWeights w a b,⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hN,hScore,rfl⟩,hPos,hSum,hEdge,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [hSupp];exact Finset.erase_subset _ _
    · rw [hSupp]
      exact Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem (by simp [positiveGraphSupport,hb])
  by_cases hScore : graphNeighborMass R w y≤graphNeighborMass R w x
  · exact hDo x y hx' hy' hxy hNon hScore
  · exact hDo y x hy' hx' (Ne.symm hxy) (fun h => hNon (hR h)) (le_of_not_ge hScore)

theorem finite_weight_merging {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a,0≤w a) :
    ∃ q : α → ℝ,(∀ a,0≤q a) ∧ (∑ a,q a)=∑ a,w a ∧
      graphEdgeMass R w≤graphEdgeMass R q ∧ positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧
      hasCliqueSupport R q ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (graphMergeStep R) w q := by
  classical
  have aux (k : ℕ) : ∀ p : α → ℝ,(∀ a,0≤p a) → (positiveGraphSupport p).card=k →
      ∃ q : α → ℝ,(∀ a,0≤q a) ∧ (∑ a,q a)=∑ a,p a ∧
        graphEdgeMass R p≤graphEdgeMass R q ∧ positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport p ∧
        hasCliqueSupport R q ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (graphMergeStep R) p q := by
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro p hp hk
      by_cases hC : hasCliqueSupport R p
      · exact ⟨p,hp,rfl,le_rfl,Finset.Subset.refl _,hC,Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
      · obtain ⟨v,hStep,hv,hSum,hEdge,hSubset,hCard⟩ := graph_merge_reduction R hR hIr p hp hC
        obtain ⟨q,hq,hqSum,hqEdge,hqSubset,hqClique,hqReach⟩ := ih (positiveGraphSupport v).card
          (by omega) v hv rfl
        refine ⟨q,hq,hqSum.trans hSum,hEdge.trans hqEdge,hqSubset.trans hSubset,hqClique,?_⟩
        exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hStep).trans hqReach
  exact aux _ w hw rfl



theorem clique_edge_mass_formula {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a) (q : α → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a,0≤q a) (hmass : ∑ a,q a=1) (hClique : hasCliqueSupport R q) :
    graphEdgeMass R q=1-∑ a,q a^2 := by
  classical
  have hp (a b : α) : (if R a b then q a*q b else 0)=q a*q b-(if a=b then q a^2 else 0) := by
    by_cases hab : a=b
    · subst b;simp [hIr a,pow_two]
    · by_cases ha : q a=0
      · simp [ha,hab]
      · by_cases hb : q b=0
        · simp [hb,hab]
        · have hRa : a∈positiveGraphSupport q := by simp [positiveGraphSupport,lt_of_le_of_ne (hq a) (Ne.symm ha)]
          have hRb : b∈positiveGraphSupport q := by simp [positiveGraphSupport,lt_of_le_of_ne (hq b) (Ne.symm hb)]
          simp [hClique a hRa b hRb hab,hab]
  unfold graphEdgeMass graphBilinear
  simp_rw [hp,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp [← Finset.mul_sum,hmass]

theorem probability_support_cauchy {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (q : α → ℝ) (hq : ∀ a,0≤q a) (hmass : ∑ a,q a=1) :
    1≤((positiveGraphSupport q).card : ℝ)*(∑ a,q a^2) := by
  classical
  let S := positiveGraphSupport q
  have hOutside (a : α) (ha : a∉S) : q a=0 := by
    have hn : ¬0<q a := by simpa [S,positiveGraphSupport] using ha
    linarith [hq a]
  have hSum : ∑ a∈S,q a=1 := by
    rw [← hmass]
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun a _ ha => hOutside a ha)
  have hSq : ∑ a∈S,q a^2=∑ a,q a^2 := by
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun a _ ha => by rw [hOutside a ha];ring)
  have hC := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq S q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  simp only [mul_one,one_pow,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one,hSum,hSq,one_pow] at hC
  nlinarith

theorem weighted_clique_extraction {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a,0≤w a) (hmass : ∑ a,w a=1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (hEdge : 1-1/((n : ℝ)-1)<graphEdgeMass R w) :
    ∃ q : α → ℝ,(∀ a,0≤q a) ∧ (∑ a,q a)=1 ∧
      positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧ hasCliqueSupport R q ∧
      n≤(positiveGraphSupport q).card ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (graphMergeStep R) w q := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqSum,hqEdge,hqSubset,hqClique,hqReach⟩ := finite_weight_merging R hR hIr w hw
  have hMass : ∑ a,q a=1 := hqSum.trans hmass
  refine ⟨q,hq,hMass,hqSubset,hqClique,?_,hqReach⟩
  have hN : 0<(n : ℝ)-1 := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<(n : ℤ)-1 by omega)
  have hCauchy := probability_support_cauchy q hq hMass
  have hFormula := clique_edge_mass_formula R hIr q hq hMass hqClique
  have hSq : 0≤∑ a,q a^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
  by_contra hCard
  have hCard' : ((positiveGraphSupport q).card : ℝ)≤(n : ℝ)-1 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show ((positiveGraphSupport q).card : ℤ)≤(n : ℤ)-1 by omega)
  have hSmall : ∑ a,q a^2<1/((n : ℝ)-1) := by linarith
  have hProd := (lt_div_iff₀ hN).mp hSmall
  have hBound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCard' hSq
  nlinarith



theorem graph_energy_lower_bound {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hIr : ∀ a,¬R a a) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ a,0≤w a) (hmass : ∑ a,w a=1) (P : α → α → ℝ) (D a : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ x y,0≤P x y) (hDiag : ∀ x,P x x=D)
    (hGap : ∀ x y,0<w x → 0<w y → x≠y → ¬R x y → a^2≤P x y) :
    a^2*(1-graphEdgeMass R w)+(D-a^2)*collision w≤weightedTotal w P := by
  classical
  have hp (x y : α) : a^2*(w x*w y-(if R x y then w x*w y else 0))+
      (D-a^2)*(if x=y then w x^2 else 0)≤w x*w y*P x y := by
    by_cases hxy : x=y
    · subst y;simp only [hIr x,ite_false,ite_true,hDiag];nlinarith
    · simp only [hxy,ite_false,mul_zero,add_zero]
      by_cases hRxy : R x y
      · simp only [hRxy,ite_true,sub_self,mul_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw x) (hw y)) (hP x y)
      · simp only [hRxy,ite_false,sub_zero]
        by_cases hx : w x=0
        · simp [hx]
        · by_cases hy : w y=0
          · simp [hy]
          · have hg := hGap x y (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw x) (Ne.symm hx))
              (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw y) (Ne.symm hy)) hxy hRxy
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw x) (hw y)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hg)]
  have hSum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x (_ : x∈Finset.univ) => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y (_ : y∈Finset.univ) => hp x y
  have hMassPair : (∑ x,∑ y,w x*w y)=1 := by
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum,hmass,mul_one]
  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,ite_true,hMassPair,hmass,mul_one,graphEdgeMass,graphBilinear,collision,weightedTotal] using hSum

theorem energy_collision_clique_certificate {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) (hR : Symmetric R) (hIr : ∀ x,¬R x x)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x,0≤w x) (hmass : ∑ x,w x=1)
    (P : α → α → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2≤n) (a E : ℝ) (ha : 0<a)
    (hP : ∀ x y,0≤P x y) (hDiag : ∀ x,P x x=(n : ℝ)^2)
    (hGap : ∀ x y,0<w x → 0<w y → x≠y → ¬R x y → a^2≤P x y)
    (hTotal : weightedTotal w P=(n : ℝ)+E)
    (hCert : ((n : ℝ)^2-a^2)*collision w>(n : ℝ)+E-a^2/((n : ℝ)-1)) :
    ∃ q : α → ℝ,(∀ x,0≤q x) ∧ (∑ x,q x)=1 ∧
      positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧ hasCliqueSupport R q ∧
      n≤(positiveGraphSupport q).card ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (graphMergeStep R) w q := by
  have hLow := graph_energy_lower_bound R hIr w hw hmass P ((n : ℝ)^2) a hP hDiag hGap
  rw [hTotal] at hLow
  have hPos : 0<a^2 := sq_pos_of_pos ha
  have hd : a^2/((n : ℝ)-1)=a^2*(1/((n : ℝ)-1)) := by ring
  rw [hd] at hCert
  apply weighted_clique_extraction R hR hIr w hw hmass n hn
  nlinarith



def signMomentMatrix {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] (v : α → ι → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) : Matrix ι ι ℝ :=
  fun i j => ∑ a,w a*v a i*v a j

def signMomentError {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : α → ι → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i,∑ j,(signMomentMatrix v w i j-(1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i j)^2

theorem sign_moment_energy_identity {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (v : α → ι → ℝ) (w : α → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ a i,v a i=1 ∨ v a i= -1)
    (hmass : ∑ a,w a=1) :
    weightedTotal w (fun a b => inner v a b^2)=(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)+signMomentError v w := by
  classical
  have hTrace : weightedTotal w (fun a b => inner v a b^2)=∑ i,∑ j,signMomentMatrix v w i j^2 := by
    unfold weightedTotal inner
    calc
      (∑ a,∑ b,w a*w b*(∑ i,v a i*v b i)^2)=
          ∑ a,∑ b,∑ i,∑ j,w a*w b*(v a i*v b i)*(v a j*v b j) := by
        simp only [pow_two,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro a ha
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro b hb
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro j hj
        ring
      _=∑ a,∑ i,∑ j,∑ b,w a*w b*(v a i*v b i)*(v a j*v b j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro a ha
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro i hi
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _=∑ i,∑ j,∑ a,∑ b,w a*w b*(v a i*v b i)*(v a j*v b j) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro i hi
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _=_ := by
        simp only [signMomentMatrix,pow_two,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro j hj
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro a ha
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro b hb
        ring
  have hDiag (i : ι) : signMomentMatrix v w i i=1 := by
    unfold signMomentMatrix
    convert hmass using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    rcases hsign a i with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> ring
  have hEntry (i j : ι) : signMomentMatrix v w i j^2=
      (signMomentMatrix v w i j-(1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i j)^2+(1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i j := by
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst j;simp [hDiag,Matrix.one_apply]
    · simp [Matrix.one_apply,hij]
  rw [hTrace]

theorem clique_sign_rows_hadamard {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 0<n) (v : α → Fin n → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ a i,v a i=1 ∨ v a i= -1)
    (S : Finset α) (hCard : n≤S.card)
    (hOrth : ∀ a∈S,∀ b∈S,a≠b → inner v a b=0) :
    ∃ rows : Fin n ↪ α,(∀ i,rows i∈S) ∧
      Matrix.IsHadamard (fun i j => v (rows i) j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T,hTS,hTcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hCard
  let e : Fin n ≃ ↥T := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_coe,hTcard])
  let rows : Fin n ↪ α := ⟨fun i => (e i).val,fun i j h => e.injective (Subtype.ext h)⟩
  have hRows (i : Fin n) : rows i∈S := hTS (e i).property
  let H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun i j => v (rows i) j
  letI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0,hn⟩⟩
  have hGram : H*H.transpose=(n : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    change (∑ k : Fin n,v (rows i) k*v (rows j) k)=(n : ℝ)*(if i=j then 1 else 0)
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst j
      have hs (k : Fin n) : v (rows i) k*v (rows i) k=1 := by
        rcases hsign (rows i) k with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
      simp [hs]
    · simpa only [inner,hij,ite_false,mul_zero] using hOrth (rows i) (hRows i) (rows j) (hRows j)
        (fun h => hij (rows.injective h))
  refine ⟨rows,hRows,?_⟩
  exact EntropyDesigns.Completion.isHadamard_mathlib ⟨(fun i j => hsign (rows i) j),by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hGram⟩

theorem collision_moment_sign_certificate {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 2≤n) (v : α → Fin n → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ x i,v x i=1 ∨ v x i= -1)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x,0≤w x) (hmass : ∑ x,w x=1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a)
    (hGap : ∀ x y,0<w x → 0<w y → x≠y → inner v x y≠0 → a^2 ≤ inner v x y^2)
    (hCert : ((n : ℝ)^2-a^2)*collision w>(n : ℝ)+signMomentError v w-a^2/((n : ℝ)-1)) :
    ∃ (q : α → ℝ) (rows : Fin n ↪ α),
      (∀ x,0≤q x) ∧ (∑ x,q x)=1 ∧ positiveGraphSupport q⊆positiveGraphSupport w ∧
      hasCliqueSupport (fun x y => inner v x y=0) q ∧
      Relation.ReflTransGen (graphMergeStep (fun x y => inner v x y=0)) w q ∧
      (∀ i,rows i∈positiveGraphSupport q) ∧
      Matrix.IsHadamard (fun i j => v (rows i) j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hDiag (x : α) : inner v x x=(n : ℝ) := by
    unfold inner
    have hx (i : Fin n) : v x i*v x i=1 := by rcases hsign x i with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
    simp [hx]
  have hSym : Symmetric (fun x y => inner v x y=0) := by
    intro x y h
    simpa only [inner,mul_comm] using h
  have hIr : ∀ x,¬inner v x x=0 := by
    intro x;rw [hDiag];exact_mod_cast (show n≠0 by omega)
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqMass,hSubset,hClique,hCard,hReach⟩ := energy_collision_clique_certificate
    (fun x y => inner v x y=0) hSym hIr w hw hmass (fun x y => inner v x y^2) n hn a
    (signMomentError v w) ha (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun x => by rw [hDiag]) hGap
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using sign_moment_energy_identity v w hsign hmass) hCert
  obtain ⟨rows,hRows,hHad⟩ := clique_sign_rows_hadamard (by omega) v hsign (positiveGraphSupport q) hCard hClique
  exact ⟨q,rows,hq,hqMass,hSubset,hClique,hReach,hRows,hHad⟩



theorem even_integer_sign_inner_gap {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : n%2=0)
    (A : α → Fin n → ℤ) (hA : ∀ x i,A x i=1 ∨ A x i= -1) (x y : α)
    (hNZ : inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y≠0) :
    (2 : ℝ)^2 ≤ inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y^2 := by
  let f : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => A x i*A y i
  have hf (i : Fin n) (_ : i∈Finset.univ) : f i=1 ∨ f i= -1 := by
    rcases hA x i with h|h <;> rcases hA y i with h'|h' <;> simp [f,h,h']
  have h4 := sign_sum_mod_four Finset.univ f hf
  have hp := prod_sign Finset.univ f hf
  have hEven : (∑ i,f i)%2=0 := by
    simp only [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] at h4
    have hn' : (n : ℤ)%2=0 := by omega
    rcases hp with hp|hp <;> rw [hp] at h4 <;> omega
  have hCast : ((∑ i,f i : ℤ) : ℝ)=inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y := by
    simp [inner,f]
  have hNZ' : (∑ i,f i)≠0 := by intro h;apply hNZ;rw [← hCast,h];norm_num
  have hh : (∑ i,f i)≤ -2 ∨ 2≤(∑ i,f i) := by omega
  have hSq : (4 : ℤ)≤(∑ i,f i)^2 := by rcases hh with h|h <;> nlinarith
  rw [← hCast]
  exact_mod_cast hSq

theorem same_parity_integer_sign_inner_gap {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : n%4=0)
    (A : α → Fin n → ℤ) (hA : ∀ x i,A x i=1 ∨ A x i= -1) (x y : α)
    (hParity : (∏ i,A x i)=(∏ i,A y i))
    (hNZ : inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y≠0) :
    (4 : ℝ)^2 ≤ inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y^2 := by

  have hpX := prod_sign Finset.univ (A x) (fun i _ => hA x i)
  have hp : (∏ i,f i)=1 := by
    simp only [f,Finset.prod_mul_distrib,hParity]
    rcases hpX with h|h <;> rw [hParity] at h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have h4 := sign_sum_mod_four Finset.univ f hf
  simp only [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,hp,sub_add_cancel] at h4
  have hMod : (∑ i,f i)%4=0 := by omega
  have hCast : ((∑ i,f i : ℤ) : ℝ)=inner (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) x y := by simp [inner,f]
  have hNZ' : (∑ i,f i)≠0 := by intro h;apply hNZ;rw [← hCast,h];norm_num
  have hh : (∑ i,f i)≤ -4 ∨ 4≤(∑ i,f i) := by omega
  have hSq : (16 : ℤ)≤(∑ i,f i)^2 := by rcases hh with h|h <;> nlinarith
  rw [← hCast]
  exact_mod_cast hSq

theorem signMomentError_zero_of_isotropic {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorem collision_threshold_algebra (n a : ℝ) (hn : 1<n) (ha : 0<a) (han : a<n) :
    (n^2-a^2)*(1/n-a^2/(n*(n-1)*(n^2-a^2)))=n-a^2/(n-1) := by
  have hn0 : n≠0 := by linarith
  have hn1 : n-1≠0 := by linarith
  have hD : n^2-a^2≠0 := by nlinarith
  field_simp
  <;> ring

theorem exact_moment_collision_gap {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 2≤n) (v : α → Fin n → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ x i,v x i=1 ∨ v x i= -1)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x,0≤w x) (hmass : ∑ x,w x=1)
    (hiso : ∀ i j,∑ x,w x*v x i*v x j=if i=j then 1 else 0)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (han : a<n)
    (hGap : ∀ x y,0<w x → 0<w y → x≠y → inner v x y≠0 → a^2 ≤ inner v x y^2) :
    (1/(n : ℝ)-a^2/((n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)-1)*((n : ℝ)^2-a^2))<collision w →
      ∃ rows : Fin n ↪ α,(∀ i,0<w (rows i)) ∧
        Matrix.IsHadamard (fun i j => v (rows i) j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) ∧
    (¬(∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,Matrix.IsHadamard H) →
      collision w≤1/(n : ℝ)-a^2/((n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)-1)*((n : ℝ)^2-a^2))) := by
  classical
  have hExtract (hC : 1/(n : ℝ)-a^2/((n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)-1)*((n : ℝ)^2-a^2))<collision w) :
      ∃ rows : Fin n ↪ α,(∀ i,0<w (rows i)) ∧
        Matrix.IsHadamard (fun i j => v (rows i) j : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    have hnR : (1 : ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1<n by omega)
    have hPos : 0<(n : ℝ)^2-a^2 := by nlinarith
    have hCert := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hC hPos
    rw [collision_threshold_algebra (n : ℝ) a hnR ha han] at hCert
    have hE := signMomentError_zero_of_isotropic v w hiso
    obtain ⟨q,rows,hq,hMass,hSubset,hClique,hReach,hRows,hHad⟩ := collision_moment_sign_certificate
      hn v hsign w hw hmass a ha hGap (by simpa only [hE,add_zero] using hCert)
    refine ⟨rows,?_,hHad⟩
    intro i;exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hSubset (hRows i))).2
  refine ⟨hExtract,?_⟩
  intro hNo
  by_contra hC
  obtain ⟨rows,hRows,hHad⟩ := hExtract (lt_of_not_ge hC)
  exact hNo ⟨_,hHad⟩



def HasSupportedHadamard {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {n : ℕ}
    (A : α → Fin n → ℤ) (w : α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ rows : Fin n ↪ α,(∀ i,0<w (rows i)) ∧
    Matrix.IsHadamard (fun i j => (A (rows i) j : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)

theorem explicit_collision_gap {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 4≤n) (hEven : n%2=0) (A : α → Fin n → ℤ) (hA : ∀ x i,A x i=1 ∨ A x i= -1)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x,0≤w x) (hmass : ∑ x,w x=1)
    (hiso : ∀ i j,∑ x,w x*(A x i : ℝ)*(A x j : ℝ)=if i=j then 1 else 0) :
    let c2 := 1/(n : ℝ)-4/((n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)-1)*((n : ℝ)^2-4))
    (c2<collision w → HasSupportedHadamard A w) ∧
    (¬(∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,Matrix.IsHadamard H) → collision w≤c2) ∧
    (4<n → n%4=0 → (∀ x y,0<w x → 0<w y → (∏ i,A x i)=(∏ i,A y i)) →
      let c4 := 1/(n : ℝ)-16/((n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)-1)*((n : ℝ)^2-16))
      (c4<collision w → HasSupportedHadamard A w) ∧
      (¬(∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,Matrix.IsHadamard H) → collision w≤c4)) := by
  have hSign : ∀ x i,(A x i : ℝ)=1 ∨ (A x i : ℝ)= -1 := by
    intro x i;rcases hA x i with h|h <;> simp [h]
  have h2 := exact_moment_collision_gap (by omega) (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) hSign w hw hmass hiso
    2 (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast (show 2<n by omega))
    (fun x y _ _ _ hNZ => even_integer_sign_inner_gap hEven A hA x y hNZ)
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨by simpa only [HasSupportedHadamard,show (2 : ℝ)^2=4 by norm_num] using h2.1,
    by simpa only [show (2 : ℝ)^2=4 by norm_num] using h2.2,?_⟩
  intro hn4 hFour hParity
  have h4 := exact_moment_collision_gap (by omega) (fun x i => (A x i : ℝ)) hSign w hw hmass hiso
    4 (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hn4)
    (fun x y hx hy _ hNZ => same_parity_integer_sign_inner_gap hFour A hA x y (hParity x y hx hy) hNZ)
  simpa only [HasSupportedHadamard,show (4 : ℝ)^2=16 by norm_num] using h4

def outsideLawMass {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (q : α → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x∈Sᶜ,q x

theorem unit_interpolation_coordinate_bound {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,x∉S → p x=0) (hq : ∀ x,0≤q x)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hMoment : ∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x) :
    ∀ s : S,|q s-p s|≤outsideLawMass S q := by
  classical
  intro s
  have hRestricted (r : α → ℝ) : (∑ x∈S,r x*L s x)=r s := by
    calc
      _=∑ x∈S,if x=s.val then r x else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x hx
        rw [hInterpolation s x hx]
        by_cases hxs : x=s.val <;> simp [hxs]
      _=_ := by simp [s.property]
  have hOutsideP : (∑ x∈Sᶜ,p x*L s x)=0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    rw [hp x (Finset.mem_compl.mp hx),zero_mul]
  have hM := hMoment s
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun x => q x*L s x),
    ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun x => p x*L s x),hRestricted q,hRestricted p,hOutsideP,add_zero] at hM
  have hDiff : q s-p s= -(∑ x∈Sᶜ,q x*L s x) := by linarith
  rw [hDiff,abs_neg]
  calc
    _≤∑ x∈Sᶜ,|q x*L s x| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _≤outsideLawMass S q := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x hx
      rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hq x)]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hBound s x) (hq x)).trans_eq (mul_one _)

theorem unit_interpolation_norm_bounds {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,x∉S → p x=0) (hq : ∀ x,0≤q x)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hMoment : ∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x) :
    ‖q-p‖≤outsideLawMass S q ∧
      (∑ x,|q x-p x|)≤((S.card : ℝ)+1)*outsideLawMass S q := by
  classical
  have hE : 0≤outsideLawMass S q := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => hq x)
  have hInside := unit_interpolation_coordinate_bound S p q L hp hq hInterpolation hBound hMoment
  have hPoint (x : α) : |q x-p x|≤outsideLawMass S q := by
    by_cases hx : x∈S
    · exact hInside ⟨x,hx⟩
    · rw [hp x hx,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (hq x)]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => hq y) (Finset.mem_compl.mpr hx)
  constructor
  · exact (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hE).mpr (fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,Pi.sub_apply] using hPoint x)
  · rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun x => |q x-p x|)]
    have hS : (∑ x∈S,|q x-p x|)≤(S.card : ℝ)*outsideLawMass S q := by
      calc
        _≤∑ _∈S,outsideLawMass S q := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => hInside ⟨x,hx⟩)
        _=_ := by simp
    have hOut : (∑ x∈Sᶜ,|q x-p x|)=outsideLawMass S q := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      rw [hp x (Finset.mem_compl.mp hx),sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (hq x)]
    rw [hOut]
    nlinarith


theorem unit_interpolation_collision_bound {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (hS : 0<S.card) (p q : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,p x=if x∈S then 1/(S.card : ℝ) else 0) (hMassP : ∑ x,p x=1)
    (hq : ∀ x,0≤q x) (hMassQ : ∑ x,q x=1)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hMoment : ∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x) :
    ‖q-p‖≤outsideLawMass S q ∧
      collision q-collision p≤outsideLawMass S q*
        (-2/(S.card : ℝ)+((S.card : ℝ)+1)*‖q-p‖) := by
  classical
  have hPout (x : α) (hx : x∉S) : p x=0 := by simp [hp,hx]
  obtain ⟨hNorm,hL1⟩ := unit_interpolation_norm_bounds S p q L hPout hq hInterpolation hBound hMoment
  have hOutsideP : (∑ x∈Sᶜ,p x)=0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun x hx => hPout x (Finset.mem_compl.mp hx))
  have hSumS : (∑ x∈S,(q x-p x))= -outsideLawMass S q := by
    have hP := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S p
    have hQ := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S q
    rw [hMassP,hOutsideP,add_zero] at hP
    rw [hMassQ] at hQ
    change (∑ x∈S,q x)+(outsideLawMass S q)=1 at hQ
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hP]
    linarith
  have hDot : lawOverlap p (q-p)= -(outsideLawMass S q)/(S.card : ℝ) := by
    unfold lawOverlap
    have hSum : (∑ x,p x*(q-p) x)=∑ x∈S,(1/(S.card : ℝ))*(q x-p x) := by
      have hRestrict : (∑ x∈S,p x*(q-p) x)=(∑ x,p x*(q-p) x) :=
        Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun x _ hx => by rw [hPout x hx,zero_mul])
      rw [← hRestrict]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      simp only [hp x,if_pos hx,Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [hSum,← Finset.mul_sum,hSumS]
    ring
  have hQuadratic : collision (q-p)≤‖q-p‖*(∑ x,|q x-p x|) := by
    unfold collision
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x hx
    have hAbs : |q x-p x|≤‖q-p‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,Pi.sub_apply] using norm_le_pi_norm (q-p) x
    have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAbs (abs_nonneg (q x-p x))
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply,← pow_two,sq_abs] using hMul
  have hQuadBound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL1 (norm_nonneg (q-p))
  have hInc := collision_direction_expansion p (q-p) 1
  have hFun : (fun x => p x+1*(q-p) x)=q := by funext x;simp
  rw [hFun,hDot] at hInc
  simp only [one_mul,one_pow,mul_one] at hInc
  refine ⟨hNorm,?_⟩
  have hDiv : -(outsideLawMass S q)/(S.card : ℝ)= -(outsideLawMass S q)*(1/(S.card : ℝ)) := by ring
  rw [hDiv] at hInc
  have hRhs : outsideLawMass S q*(-2/(S.card : ℝ)+((S.card : ℝ)+1)*‖q-p‖)=
      -2*outsideLawMass S q*(1/(S.card : ℝ))+‖q-p‖*(((S.card : ℝ)+1)*outsideLawMass S q) := by ring
  rw [hRhs]
  nlinarith

theorem unit_interpolation_strict_radius {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (hS : 0<S.card) (p q : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,p x=if x∈S then 1/(S.card : ℝ) else 0) (hMassP : ∑ x,p x=1)
    (hq : ∀ x,0≤q x) (hMassQ : ∑ x,q x=1)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hMoment : ∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x)
    (hqp : q≠p) (hClose : ‖q-p‖<2/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1))) :
    collision q<collision p := by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ)<S.card := by exact_mod_cast hS
  have hm1 : 0<(S.card : ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hNorm,hCollision⟩ := unit_interpolation_collision_bound S hS p q L hp hMassP hq hMassQ hInterpolation hBound hMoment
  have hE : 0<outsideLawMass S q := (norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hqp)).trans_le hNorm
  have hScale := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hClose hm1
  have hCancel : ((S.card : ℝ)+1)*(2/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1)))=2/(S.card : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hCancel] at hScale
  have hNeg : -2/(S.card : ℝ)+((S.card : ℝ)+1)*‖q-p‖<0 := by rw [neg_div];linarith
  have hProd := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hE hNeg
  linarith



theorem unit_interpolation_vertex {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ) (P : Set (α → ℝ))
    (hpP : p∈P) (hp : ∀ x,x∉S → p x=0)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hNonneg : ∀ q∈P,∀ x,0≤q x)
    (hMoment : ∀ q∈P,∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x) :
    p∈Set.extremePoints ℝ P := by
  classical
  refine ⟨hpP,?_⟩
  intro q hq r hr hSegment
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hCombo⟩ := hSegment
  have hOutside (x : α) (hx : x∉S) : q x=0 := by
    have hh := congrFun hCombo x
    change a*q x+b*r x=p x at hh
    rw [hp x hx] at hh
    have hQ := hNonneg q hq x
    have hR := hNonneg r hr x
    have hRmul := mul_nonneg hb.le hR
    have hMul : a*q x=0 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hMul).resolve_left ha.ne'
  have hOutsideMass : outsideLawMass S q=0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero
    (fun x hx => hOutside x (Finset.mem_compl.mp hx))
  have hNorm := (unit_interpolation_norm_bounds S p q L hp (hNonneg q hq) hInterpolation hBound (hMoment q hq)).1
  rw [hOutsideMass] at hNorm
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hNorm (norm_nonneg _)))

theorem unit_interpolation_shell_drop {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (hS : 0<S.card) (p q : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,p x=if x∈S then 1/(S.card : ℝ) else 0) (hMassP : ∑ x,p x=1)
    (hq : ∀ x,0≤q x) (hMassQ : ∑ x,q x=1)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (hMoment : ∀ s,∑ x,q x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x)
    (hDistance : ‖q-p‖=1/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1))) :
    collision q≤collision p-1/((S.card : ℝ)^2*((S.card : ℝ)+1)) := by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ)<S.card := by exact_mod_cast hS
  have hm1 : 0<(S.card : ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hNorm,hCollision⟩ := unit_interpolation_collision_bound S hS p q L hp hMassP hq hMassQ hInterpolation hBound hMoment
  have hBracket : -2/(S.card : ℝ)+((S.card : ℝ)+1)*(1/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1)))= -1/(S.card : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hDistance] at hNorm hCollision
  rw [hBracket] at hCollision
  have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNorm (show 0≤1/(S.card : ℝ) by positivity)
  have hGap : (1/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1)))*(1/(S.card : ℝ))=
      1/((S.card : ℝ)^2*((S.card : ℝ)+1)) := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hGap] at hMul
  rw [neg_div,mul_neg] at hCollision
  linarith



theorem unit_interpolation_path_barrier {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (hS : 0<S.card) (p : α → ℝ) (L : S → α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x,p x=if x∈S then 1/(S.card : ℝ) else 0) (hMassP : ∑ x,p x=1)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ s : S,∀ x∈S,L s x=if x=s.val then 1 else 0)
    (hBound : ∀ s x,|L s x|≤1)
    (path : ℝ → (α → ℝ)) (hContinuous : ContinuousOn path (Set.Icc 0 1))
    (hStart : path 0=p) (hEnd : collision p<collision (path 1))
    (hLaw : ∀ t∈Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,(∀ x,0≤path t x) ∧ (∑ x,path t x)=1 ∧
      ∀ s,∑ x,path t x*L s x=∑ x,p x*L s x) :
    ∃ t∈Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,collision (path t)≤collision p-1/((S.card : ℝ)^2*((S.card : ℝ)+1)) := by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ)<S.card := by exact_mod_cast hS
  have hm1 : 0<(S.card : ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  have hEndpointNe : path 1≠p := by intro h;rw [h] at hEnd;exact lt_irrefl _ hEnd
  have hLawEnd := hLaw 1 (by norm_num)
  have hFar : 2/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1))≤‖path 1-p‖ := by
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hClose
    have hDrop := unit_interpolation_strict_radius S hS p (path 1) L hp hMassP
      hLawEnd.1 hLawEnd.2.1 hInterpolation hBound hLawEnd.2.2 hEndpointNe hClose
    linarith
  let ρ := 1/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1))
  have hρ : 0<ρ := by dsimp only [ρ];positivity
  have hρFar : ρ≤‖path 1-p‖ := by
    have hTwo : 2/((S.card : ℝ)*((S.card : ℝ)+1))=2*ρ := by dsimp only [ρ];ring
    rw [hTwo] at hFar
    linarith
  have hDistanceContinuous : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ‖path t-p‖) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
    (hContinuous.sub continuousOn_const).norm
  have hTarget : ρ∈Set.Icc ‖path 0-p‖ ‖path 1-p‖ := by
    rw [hStart,sub_self,norm_zero]
    exact ⟨hρ.le,hρFar⟩
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hDistance⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (by norm_num) hDistanceContinuous hTarget
  have hLawT := hLaw t ht
  refine ⟨t,ht,?_⟩
  exact unit_interpolation_shell_drop S hS p (path t) L hp hMassP hLawT.1 hLawT.2.1
    hInterpolation hBound hLawT.2.2 hDistance



def trapFirstCharacter {s : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin s)) (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) : ℤ :=
  if h : S=∅ then 1 else bitSign (x ⟨Sum.inl S,fun he => h (Sum.inl.inj he)⟩)

def trapSecondCharacter {s : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin s)) (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) : ℤ :=
  if S=∅ then 1 else bitSign (x ⟨Sum.inr S,by intro h;cases h⟩)

theorem trapFirstCharacter_sign {s : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin s)) (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) :
    trapFirstCharacter S x=1 ∨ trapFirstCharacter S x= -1 := by
  unfold trapFirstCharacter
  split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact bitSign_sign _

theorem trapSecondCharacter_sign {s : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin s)) (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) :
    trapSecondCharacter S x=1 ∨ trapSecondCharacter S x= -1 := by
  unfold trapSecondCharacter
  split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact bitSign_sign _

theorem trapFirstCharacter_code {s : ℕ} (e S : Finset (Fin s)) (u : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool)) :
    trapFirstCharacter S (trapCode e u)=walshChar S u.1 := by
  unfold trapFirstCharacter
  split_ifs with h
  · subst S;simp [walshChar]
  · rw [trapCode_sign]
    rfl

theorem trapSecondCharacter_code {s : ℕ} (e S : Finset (Fin s)) (u : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool)) :
    trapSecondCharacter S (trapCode e u)=walshChar S u.2 := by
  unfold trapSecondCharacter
  split_ifs with h
  · subst S;simp [walshChar]
  · rw [trapCode_sign]
    simp [trapRow,h]

theorem trap_first_character_mean {s : ℕ} (q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hq : observedFeasible q) (S : Finset (Fin s)) :
    (∑ x,q x*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ))=if S=∅ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S=∅
  · simp [trapFirstCharacter,hS,hq.2.1]
  · simpa only [trapFirstCharacter,dif_neg hS,if_neg hS] using hq.2.2.1 ⟨Sum.inl S,fun he => hS (Sum.inl.inj he)⟩

theorem trap_second_character_mean {s : ℕ} (q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hq : observedFeasible q) (S : Finset (Fin s)) :
    (∑ x,q x*(trapSecondCharacter S x : ℝ))=if S=∅ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S=∅
  · simp [trapSecondCharacter,hS,hq.2.1]
  · simpa only [trapSecondCharacter,if_neg hS] using hq.2.2.1 ⟨Sum.inr S,by intro h;cases h⟩

theorem trap_character_cross_moment {s : ℕ} (q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hq : observedFeasible q) (S T : Finset (Fin s)) :
    (∑ x,q x*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ))=
      if S=∅ ∧ T=∅ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hS : S=∅
  · subst S
    simpa [trapFirstCharacter] using trap_second_character_mean q hq T
  · by_cases hT : T=∅
    · subst T
      simpa [trapSecondCharacter,hS] using trap_first_character_mean q hq S
    · let i : TrapCoordinate s := ⟨Sum.inl S,fun he => hS (Sum.inl.inj he)⟩
      let j : TrapCoordinate s := ⟨Sum.inr T,by intro h;cases h⟩
      have hij : i≠j := by intro h;have he := congrArg Subtype.val h;cases he
      have hh := hq.2.2.2 i j hij
      simpa [trapFirstCharacter,trapSecondCharacter,hS,hT,i,j] using hh


def seedTrapInterpolation {s : ℕ} (u : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool))
    (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) : ℝ :=
  (1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))*(∑ S : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ))*
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ))

theorem seedTrapInterpolation_bounded {s : ℕ} (u : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool))
    (x : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) : |seedTrapInterpolation u x|≤1 := by
  have hAbs (z : ℤ) (hz : z=1 ∨ z= -1) : |(z : ℝ)|=1 := by rcases hz with rfl|rfl <;> norm_num
  have hFirst : |∑ S : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)|≤(2 : ℝ)^s := by
    calc
      _≤∑ S : Finset (Fin s),|(walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _=_ := by simp only [abs_mul,hAbs _ (walshChar_sign _ _),hAbs _ (trapFirstCharacter_sign _ _),one_mul];simp
  have hSecond : |∑ T : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ)|≤(2 : ℝ)^s := by
    calc
      _≤∑ T : Finset (Fin s),|(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _=_ := by simp only [abs_mul,hAbs _ (walshChar_sign _ _),hAbs _ (trapSecondCharacter_sign _ _),one_mul];simp
  have hProd := mul_le_mul hFirst hSecond (abs_nonneg _) (show 0≤(2 : ℝ)^s by positivity)
  have hm : (2 : ℝ)^(2*s)=(2 : ℝ)^s*(2 : ℝ)^s := by rw [two_mul,pow_add]
  calc
    |seedTrapInterpolation u x|=(1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))*
        (|∑ S : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)| *
         |∑ T : Finset (Fin s),(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ)|) := by
      rw [seedTrapInterpolation,abs_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)≤1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))]
      ring
    _≤(1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))*((2 : ℝ)^s*(2 : ℝ)^s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hProd (by positivity)
    _=1 := by rw [hm];field_simp

theorem seedTrapInterpolation_code {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s))
    (u v : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool)) :
    seedTrapInterpolation u (trapCode e v)=if v=u then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold seedTrapInterpolation
  simp_rw [trapFirstCharacter_code,trapSecondCharacter_code]
  rw [walshChar_real_dual_orthogonality,walshChar_real_dual_orthogonality]
  have hm : (2 : ℝ)^(2*s)=(2 : ℝ)^s*(2 : ℝ)^s := by rw [two_mul,pow_add]
  by_cases h1 : u.1=v.1
  · by_cases h2 : u.2=v.2
    · have heq : v=u := Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm
      simp only [h1,h2,heq,ite_true]
      rw [hm]
      field_simp
    · have hne : v≠u := fun h => h2 (congrArg Prod.snd h.symm)
      simp [h1,h2,hne]
  · have hne : v≠u := fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h.symm)
    simp [h1,hne]



theorem seedTrapInterpolation_moment {s : ℕ} (q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hq : observedFeasible q) (u : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool)) :
    (∑ x,q x*seedTrapInterpolation u x)=1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s) := by
  classical
  calc
    _=∑ x,∑ S : Finset (Fin s),∑ T : Finset (Fin s),
        (1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))*((walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ))*
          (q x*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [seedTrapInterpolation,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro x hx
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro S hS
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro T hT
      ring
    _=(1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*s))*(∑ S : Finset (Fin s),∑ T : Finset (Fin s),
        ((walshChar S u.1 : ℝ)*(walshChar T u.2 : ℝ))*
          (∑ x,q x*(trapFirstCharacter S x : ℝ)*(trapSecondCharacter T x : ℝ))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro S hS
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro T hT
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl;intro x hx
      ring
    _=_ := by
      simp_rw [trap_character_cross_moment q hq]
      simp [ite_and,walshChar]



noncomputable def trapSupportSeed {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s))
    (x : activeSupport (trapLaw e)) : (Fin s → Bool)×(Fin s → Bool) :=
  Classical.choose ((trapLaw_nonzero_iff e x.val).mp (by
    simpa only [activeSupport,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using x.property))

theorem trapSupportSeed_code {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s)) (x : activeSupport (trapLaw e)) :
    trapCode e (trapSupportSeed e x)=x.val := by
  unfold trapSupportSeed
  exact Classical.choose_spec ((trapLaw_nonzero_iff e x.val).mp (by
    simpa only [activeSupport,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using x.property))

noncomputable def trapAtomInterpolation {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s))
    (x : activeSupport (trapLaw e)) (y : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) : ℝ :=
  seedTrapInterpolation (trapSupportSeed e x) y

theorem trapLaw_observedFeasible {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s)) (he : e.Nonempty) :
    observedFeasible (trapLaw e) :=
  ⟨(trapLaw_probability e).1,(trapLaw_probability e).2,trapLaw_mean e he,trapLaw_pair e he⟩

theorem trap_atom_interpolation_delta {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s))
    (x : activeSupport (trapLaw e)) (y : TrapCoordinate s → Bool) (hy : y∈activeSupport (trapLaw e)) :
    trapAtomInterpolation e x y=if y=x.val then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := (trapLaw_nonzero_iff e y).mp (by simpa [activeSupport] using hy)
  have hEq : v=trapSupportSeed e x ↔ y=x.val := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [← hv,h,trapSupportSeed_code]
    · intro h
      apply trapCode_injective e
      rw [hv,trapSupportSeed_code,h]
  unfold trapAtomInterpolation
  have hh := seedTrapInterpolation_code e (trapSupportSeed e x) v
  rw [hv] at hh
  simpa only [hEq] using hh

theorem trap_atom_interpolation_moment {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s)) (he : e.Nonempty)
    (q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : observedFeasible q)
    (x : activeSupport (trapLaw e)) :
    (∑ y,q y*trapAtomInterpolation e x y)=(∑ y,trapLaw e y*trapAtomInterpolation e x y) := by
  unfold trapAtomInterpolation
  rw [seedTrapInterpolation_moment q hq,seedTrapInterpolation_moment _ (trapLaw_observedFeasible e he)]

theorem trapLaw_uniform_on_activeSupport {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s)) :
    ∀ x,trapLaw e x=if x∈activeSupport (trapLaw e) then
      1/((activeSupport (trapLaw e)).card : ℝ) else 0 := by
  classical
  intro x
  have hCard : (activeSupport (trapLaw e)).card=2^(2*s) := trapLaw_support_card e
  by_cases hx : x∈activeSupport (trapLaw e)
  · have hNZ : trapLaw e x≠0 := by simpa only [activeSupport,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hx
    rw [if_pos hx,hCard]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] using (trapLaw_weights e x).resolve_left hNZ
  · have hZero : trapLaw e x=0 := by simpa [activeSupport] using hx
    rw [if_neg hx,hZero]

theorem character_trap_vertex_and_radius {s : ℕ} (e : Finset (Fin s)) (he : e.Nonempty) :
    observedFeasible (trapLaw e) ∧
    trapLaw e∈Set.extremePoints ℝ {q | observedFeasible q} ∧
    (∀ q : (TrapCoordinate s → Bool) → ℝ,observedFeasible q → q≠trapLaw e →
      ‖q-trapLaw e‖<2/((2 : ℝ)^(2*s)*((2 : ℝ)^(2*s)+1)) → collision q<collision (trapLaw e)) ∧
    IsLocalMaxOn collision {q | observedFeasible q} (trapLaw e) := by
  classical
  let S := activeSupport (trapLaw e)
  have hCard : S.card=2^(2*s) := trapLaw_support_card e
  have hPos : 0<S.card := by rw [hCard];positivity
  have hP := trapLaw_observedFeasible e he

  have hVertex := unit_interpolation_vertex S (trapLaw e) (trapAtomInterpolation e) {q | observedFeasible q} hP

theorem squared_norm_increment {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w v : E) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖w+t • (v-w)‖^2=‖w‖^2+2*t*Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)+t^2*‖v-w‖^2 := by
  rw [norm_add_sq_real,inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow,sq_abs]
  ring

theorem local_norm_max_strictly_exposes {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (P : Set E) (hP : Convex ℝ P) (w : E) (hw : w∈P)
    (hMax : IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) P w) :
    ∀ v∈P,v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0 := by
  intro v hv hvw
  by_contra hNeg
  have hDot : 0 ≤ Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w) := le_of_not_gt hNeg
  let g : ℝ → E := fun t => w+t • (v-w)
  have hCont : Tendsto g (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 w) := by
    have hId : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hV : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => v-w) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (v-w)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    have hW : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => w) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 w) := tendsto_const_nhds
    have hh := hW.add (hId.smul hV)
    simpa only [zero_smul,add_zero] using hh
  have hWithin : Tendsto g (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[P] w) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨hCont,?_⟩
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,nhdsWithin_le_nhds (eventually_lt_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1))] with t ht ht1
    exact hP.add_smul_sub_mem hw hv ⟨le_of_lt ht,le_of_lt ht1⟩
  have hBound : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),‖g t‖^2≤‖w‖^2 := hWithin hMax
  have hPositive : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),0<t := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hBt⟩ := (hPositive.and hBound).exists
  have ht' : (0 : ℝ)<t := ht
  have hNorm : 0<‖v-w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hvw)
  have hInc := squared_norm_increment w v t
  change ‖w+t • (v-w)‖^2≤‖w‖^2 at hBt
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht'.le hDot,mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos ht') (sq_pos_of_pos hNorm)]

theorem finite_exposure_margin {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Finset E) (w : E) (hS : ∀ v∈S,v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0) :
    ∃ a : ℝ,0<a ∧ ∀ v∈S,Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)≤ -a*‖v-w‖ := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1,by norm_num,by simp⟩
  | @insert v S hv ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hMargin⟩ := ih (fun u hu => hS u (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu))
    by_cases hvw : v=w
    · refine ⟨a,ha,?_⟩
      intro u hu
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with hEq|hu
      · subst u;simp [hvw]
      · exact hMargin u hu
    · have hDot := hS v (Finset.mem_insert_self v S) hvw
      have hNorm : 0<‖v-w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hvw)
      let b := min a (-Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)/‖v-w‖)
      have hb : 0<b := lt_min ha (div_pos (neg_pos.mpr hDot) hNorm)
      refine ⟨b,hb,?_⟩
      intro u hu
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with hEq|hu
      · subst u
        have hB : b*‖v-w‖≤ -Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w) :=
          (le_div_iff₀ hNorm).mp (min_le_right a _)
        linarith
      · have hB : b≤a := min_le_left _ _
        have hN := norm_nonneg (u-w)
        nlinarith [hMargin u hu]


theorem exposure_margin_convex {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w : E) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0≤a) :
    Convex ℝ {v : E | Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)≤ -a*‖v-w‖} := by
  intro x hx y hy c d hc hd hcd
  have hVec : c • x+d • y-w=c • (x-w)+d • (y-w) := by
    calc
      _=c • x+d • y-(c+d) • w := by rw [hcd,one_smul]
      _=_ := by module
  change Inner.inner ℝ w (c • x+d • y-w)≤ -a*‖c • x+d • y-w‖
  rw [hVec,inner_add_right,inner_smul_right,inner_smul_right]
  have hNorm := norm_add_le (c • (x-w)) (d • (y-w))
  rw [norm_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hc,abs_of_nonneg hd] at hNorm
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hc
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hd
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNorm ha
  nlinarith

theorem finite_strict_exposure_gives_local_max {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Finset E) (w : E) (hw : w∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E))
    (hExpose : ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0) :
    IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) w ∧
      (∃ ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),v≠w → ‖v-w‖<ε → ‖v‖^2<‖w‖^2) ∧
      w∈(convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)).extremePoints ℝ := by
  classical
  let P := convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)
  have hSeed : ∀ v∈S,v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0 := fun v hv => hExpose v (subset_convexHull ℝ (S : Set E) hv)
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hMargin⟩ := finite_exposure_margin S w hSeed
  have hHull : ∀ v∈P,Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)≤ -a*‖v-w‖ := by
    exact convexHull_min hMargin (exposure_margin_convex w a ha.le)
  have hStrict (v : E) (hv : v∈P) (hvw : v≠w) (hClose : ‖v-w‖<2*a) : ‖v‖^2<‖w‖^2 := by
    have hM := hHull v hv
    have hN : 0<‖v-w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hvw)
    have hInc := squared_norm_increment w v 1
    simp only [one_smul,add_sub_cancel,one_mul,one_pow] at hInc
    nlinarith [mul_pos hN (sub_pos.mpr hClose)]
  have hLocal : IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) P w := by
    have hBall : ∀ᶠ v : E in 𝓝 w,‖v-w‖<2*a := by
      simpa only [Filter.Eventually,Metric.ball,dist_eq_norm] using Metric.ball_mem_nhds w (by linarith : 0<2*a)
    have hMem : ∀ᶠ v : E in 𝓝[P] w,v∈P := self_mem_nhdsWithin
    filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hBall,hMem] with v hClose hv
    by_cases hvw : v=w
    · subst v;exact le_rfl
    · exact (hStrict v hv hvw hClose).le
  have hExtreme : w∈P.extremePoints ℝ := by
    apply exposedPoints_subset_extremePoints
    refine ⟨hw,innerSL ℝ w,?_⟩
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvw : v=w
    · subst v;exact ⟨le_rfl,fun _ => rfl⟩
    · have hE := hExpose v hv hvw
      rw [inner_sub_right] at hE
      constructor
      · exact (sub_neg.mp hE).le
      · intro hContra
        change Inner.inner ℝ w w ≤ Inner.inner ℝ w v at hContra
        exfalso;linarith
  exact ⟨hLocal,⟨2*a,by linarith,hStrict⟩,hExtreme⟩



theorem finite_polytope_local_max_criterion {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Finset E) (w : E) (hw : w∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) :
    (IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) w ↔
      ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),Inner.inner ℝ w v≤ Inner.inner ℝ w w ∧
        (Inner.inner ℝ w w ≤ Inner.inner ℝ w v → v=w)) ∧
    (IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) w →
      (∃ ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),v≠w → ‖v-w‖<ε → ‖v‖^2<‖w‖^2) ∧
      w∈(convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)).extremePoints ℝ) := by
  have hForward (hLocal : IsLocalMaxOn (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) w) :
      ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0 :=
    local_norm_max_strictly_exposes _ (convex_convexHull ℝ (S : Set E)) w hw hLocal
  have hReverse (hLinear : ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),Inner.inner ℝ w v≤ Inner.inner ℝ w w ∧
      (Inner.inner ℝ w w ≤ Inner.inner ℝ w v → v=w)) :
      ∀ v∈convexHull ℝ (S : Set E),v≠w → Inner.inner ℝ w (v-w)<0 := by
    intro v hv hvw
    obtain ⟨hLe,hUnique⟩ := hLinear v hv
    have hNe : Inner.inner ℝ w v≠ Inner.inner ℝ w w := fun h => hvw (hUnique h.symm.le)
    rw [inner_sub_right]
    exact sub_neg.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hLe hNe)
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · intro hLocal v hv
    by_cases hvw : v=w
    · subst v;exact ⟨le_rfl,fun _ => rfl⟩
    · have hE := hForward hLocal v hv hvw
      rw [inner_sub_right] at hE
      exact ⟨(sub_neg.mp hE).le,fun h => False.elim (not_le_of_gt (sub_neg.mp hE) h)⟩
  · intro hLinear
    exact (finite_strict_exposure_gives_local_max S w hw (hReverse hLinear)).1
  · intro hLocal
    exact (finite_strict_exposure_gives_local_max S w hw (hForward hLocal)).2



theorem uniform_vertex_supported_kernel_zero {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) (hp : feasibleLaw A b p)
    (hVertex : p∈Set.extremePoints ℝ {q | feasibleLaw A b q})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hUniform : ∀ i,p i=0 ∨ p i=c)
    (z : α → ℝ) (hAz : A.mulVec z=0) (hSum : ∑ i,z i=0)
    (hSupport : ∀ i,p i=0 → z i=0) : z=0 := by
  classical
  let t := c/(2*(1+‖z‖))
  have hD : 0<2*(1+‖z‖) := by positivity
  have ht : 0<t := div_pos hc hD
  have htEq : t*(2*(1+‖z‖))=c := div_mul_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt hD)
  have htN : t*‖z‖≤c := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hCoords (i : α) : |z i|≤‖z‖ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm z i
  have hNonneg (s : ℝ) (hs : s=t ∨ s= -t) (i : α) : 0≤p i+s*z i := by
    rcases hUniform i with hp0|hpc
    · rw [hp0,hSupport i hp0];simp
    · have hzi := abs_le.mp (hCoords i)
      have hLo := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzi.1 ht.le
      have hHi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzi.2 ht.le
      rcases hs with rfl|rfl <;> rw [hpc] <;> nlinarith
  have hFeasible (s : ℝ) (hs : s=t ∨ s= -t) : feasibleLaw A b (fun i => p i+s*z i) := by
    refine ⟨hNonneg s hs,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hSum,mul_zero,add_zero,hp.2.1]
    · change A.mulVec (p+s • z)=b
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add,Matrix.mulVec_smul,hp.2.2,hAz,smul_zero,add_zero]
  let q : α → ℝ := fun i => p i+t*z i
  let r : α → ℝ := fun i => p i-t*z i
  have hq : feasibleLaw A b q := hFeasible t (Or.inl rfl)
  have hr : feasibleLaw A b r := by simpa only [r,neg_mul,sub_eq_add_neg] using hFeasible (-t) (Or.inr rfl)
  have hMid : p∈openSegment ℝ q r := by
    refine ⟨1/2,1/2,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,?_⟩
    funext i
    change (1/2 : ℝ)*(p i+t*z i)+(1/2 : ℝ)*(p i-t*z i)=p i
    ring
  have hqp : q=p := hVertex.2 hq hr hMid
  funext i
  have hh := congrFun hqp i
  change p i+t*z i=p i at hh
  have hm : t*z i=0 := by linarith
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_left ht.ne'


theorem closed_cone_strict_linear_margin {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [ProperSpace E] (C : Set E) (hClosed : IsClosed C)
    (hCone : ∀ z∈C,∀ t : ℝ,0≤t → t • z∈C)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hStrict : ∀ z∈C,z≠0 → L z<0) :
    ∃ a : ℝ,0<a ∧ ∀ z∈C,L z≤ -a*‖z‖ := by
  classical
  let S := Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1∩C
  have hCompact : IsCompact S := (isCompact_sphere (0 : E) 1).inter_right hClosed
  have hNormalize (z : E) (hz : z∈C) (hz0 : z≠0) : ‖z‖⁻¹ • z∈S := by
    refine ⟨?_,hCone z hz ‖z‖⁻¹ (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg z))⟩
    simp only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg z)),inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz0)]
  by_cases hNonempty : S.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨u,hu,hMax⟩ := hCompact.exists_isMaxOn hNonempty L.continuous.continuousOn
    have hu0 : u≠0 := by
      intro h
      have hh := hu.1
      simp [h] at hh
    have hLu : L u<0 := hStrict u hu.2 hu0
    refine ⟨-L u,neg_pos.mpr hLu,?_⟩
    intro z hz
    by_cases hz0 : z=0
    · simp [hz0]
    · have hN : 0<‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0
      have hh := hMax (hNormalize z hz hz0)
      change L (‖z‖⁻¹ • z)≤L u at hh
      rw [map_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hh
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hN.le
      have hCancel : ‖z‖*(‖z‖⁻¹*L z)=L z := by rw [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hN.ne',one_mul]
      rw [hCancel] at hm
      simpa only [neg_neg,mul_comm] using hm
  · refine ⟨1,by norm_num,?_⟩
    intro z hz
    by_cases hz0 : z=0
    · simp [hz0]
    · exact False.elim (hNonempty ⟨_,hNormalize z hz hz0⟩)


def momentTangentCone {ι α : Type*} [Fintype α] (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) : Set (α → ℝ) :=
  {z | A.mulVec z=0 ∧ (∑ i,z i)=0 ∧ ∀ i,p i=0 → 0≤z i}

def probabilityOverlapLinear {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : α → ℝ) : (α → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ∑ i,(p i) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj i

theorem probabilityOverlapLinear_apply {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p z : α → ℝ) :
    probabilityOverlapLinear p z=lawOverlap p z := by
  simp [probabilityOverlapLinear,lawOverlap]

theorem momentTangentCone_closed {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]
    (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) : IsClosed (momentTangentCone A p) := by
  have hA : IsClosed {z : α → ℝ | A.mulVec z=0} := isClosed_eq
    (continuous_pi fun i => by simp only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct];fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hSum : IsClosed {z : α → ℝ | (∑ i,z i)=0} := isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hOut : IsClosed {z : α → ℝ | ∀ i,p i=0 → 0≤z i} := by
    have hC (i : α) (_ : p i=0) : IsClosed {z : α → ℝ | 0≤z i} :=
      isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i)
    simpa only [setOf_forall] using isClosed_iInter (fun i => isClosed_iInter (fun h : p i=0 => hC i h))
  exact hA.inter (hSum.inter hOut)

theorem momentTangentCone_smul {ι α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (p z : α → ℝ) (hz : z∈momentTangentCone A p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) : t • z∈momentTangentCone A p := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul,hz.1,smul_zero]
  · simp only [Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,hz.2.1,mul_zero]
  · intro i hi;exact mul_nonneg ht (hz.2.2 i hi)

theorem uniform_vertex_tangent_strict {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) (hp : feasibleLaw A b p)
    (hVertex : p∈Set.extremePoints ℝ {q | feasibleLaw A b q})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hUniform : ∀ i,p i=0 ∨ p i=c)
    (z : α → ℝ) (hz : z∈momentTangentCone A p) (hz0 : z≠0) : lawOverlap p z<0 := by
  classical
  let e := ∑ i,if p i=0 then z i else 0
  have hTerm (i : α) : 0 ≤ (if p i=0 then z i else 0) := by
    by_cases hi : p i=0
    · simp only [hi,ite_true];exact hz.2.2 i hi
    · simp [hi]
  have he : 0≤e := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hTerm i)
  have hDot : lawOverlap p z= -c*e := by
    have hPair (i : α) : p i*z i=c*(z i-(if p i=0 then z i else 0)) := by
      by_cases hi : p i=0
      · simp [hi]
      · have hpc := (hUniform i).resolve_left hi
        rw [if_neg hi,sub_zero,hpc]
    unfold lawOverlap
    simp_rw [hPair]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hz.2.1]
    dsimp only [e]
    ring
  by_contra hBad
  have he0 : e=0 := by
    have hNot : 0 ≤ lawOverlap p z := le_of_not_gt hBad
    rw [hDot] at hNot
    nlinarith
  have hSupport (i : α) (hi : p i=0) : z i=0 := by
    have hSingle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j∈Finset.univ) => hTerm j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    change (if p i=0 then z i else 0)≤e at hSingle
    rw [hi,if_pos rfl,he0] at hSingle
    linarith [hz.2.2 i hi]
  exact hz0 (uniform_vertex_supported_kernel_zero A b p hp hVertex c hc hUniform z hz.1 hz.2.1 hSupport)



theorem uniform_vertex_strict_local_collision {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) (hp : feasibleLaw A b p)
    (hVertex : p∈Set.extremePoints ℝ {q | feasibleLaw A b q})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hUniform : ∀ i,p i=0 ∨ p i=c) :
    IsLocalMaxOn collision {q | feasibleLaw A b q} p ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀ q,feasibleLaw A b q → q≠p → ‖q-p‖<ε → collision q<collision p := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hMargin⟩ := closed_cone_strict_linear_margin (momentTangentCone A p)
    (momentTangentCone_closed A p) (fun z hz t ht => momentTangentCone_smul A p z hz t ht)
    (probabilityOverlapLinear p) (by
      intro z hz hz0
      rw [probabilityOverlapLinear_apply]
      exact uniform_vertex_tangent_strict A b p hp hVertex c hc hUniform z hz hz0)
  have hDiff (q : α → ℝ) (hq : feasibleLaw A b q) : q-p∈momentTangentCone A p := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub,hq.2.2,hp.2.2,sub_self]
    · simp only [Pi.sub_apply,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hq.2.1,hp.2.1,sub_self]
    · intro i hi;simpa only [Pi.sub_apply,hi,sub_zero] using hq.1 i
  have hCollisionNorm (z : α → ℝ) : collision z≤(Fintype.card α : ℝ)*‖z‖^2 := by
    unfold collision
    calc
      (∑ i,z i^2)≤∑ _ : α,‖z‖^2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hAbs : |z i|≤‖z‖ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm z i
        have hMul := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAbs) (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) (abs_nonneg (z i)))
        nlinarith [sq_abs (z i)]
      _=_ := by simp
  let ε := a/((Fintype.card α : ℝ)+1)
  have hDen : 0<(Fintype.card α : ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  have hε : 0<ε := div_pos ha hDen
  have hStrict (q : α → ℝ) (hq : feasibleLaw A b q) (hqp : q≠p) (hClose : ‖q-p‖<ε) :
      collision q<collision p := by
    have hM := hMargin (q-p) (hDiff q hq)
    rw [probabilityOverlapLinear_apply] at hM
    have hN : 0<‖q-p‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hqp)
    have hSmall : ‖q-p‖*((Fintype.card α : ℝ)+1)<a := (lt_div_iff₀ hDen).mp hClose
    have hScaled := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hSmall hN
    have hInc := collision_direction_expansion p (q-p) 1
    have hFun : (fun i => p i+1*(q-p) i)=q := by funext i;simp
    rw [hFun] at hInc
    simp only [one_mul,one_pow,mul_one] at hInc
    nlinarith [hCollisionNorm (q-p),mul_pos ha hN]
  refine ⟨?_,ε,hε,hStrict⟩
  have hBall : ∀ᶠ q : α → ℝ in 𝓝 p,‖q-p‖<ε := by
    simpa only [Filter.Eventually,Metric.ball,dist_eq_norm] using Metric.ball_mem_nhds p hε
  have hMem : ∀ᶠ q : α → ℝ in 𝓝[{q | feasibleLaw A b q}] p,feasibleLaw A b q := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hBall,hMem] with q hClose hq
  by_cases hqp : q=p
  · subst q;exact le_rfl
  · exact (hStrict q hq hqp hClose).le



def cubeProbabilityFeasible {d : ℕ} (w : (Fin d → Bool) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x,0≤w x) ∧ (∑ x,w x)=1 ∧
    (∀ i,∑ x,w x*(bitSign (x i) : ℝ)=0) ∧
    (∀ i j,i≠j → ∑ x,w x*(bitSign (x i) : ℝ)*(bitSign (x j) : ℝ)=0)

def cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix (d : ℕ) : Matrix (Unit ⊕ (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d×Fin d))) (Fin d → Bool) ℝ :=
  Sum.elim (fun _ _ => 1)
    (Sum.elim (fun i x => (bitSign (x i) : ℝ))
      (fun ij x => (bitSign (x ij.1) : ℝ)*(bitSign (x ij.2) : ℝ)))

def cubeProbabilityMomentTarget (d : ℕ) : Unit ⊕ (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d×Fin d)) → ℝ :=
  Sum.elim (fun _ => 1) (Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) (fun ij => if ij.1=ij.2 then 1 else 0))

theorem cube_probability_feasible_iff {d : ℕ} (w : (Fin d → Bool) → ℝ) :
    cubeProbabilityFeasible w ↔ feasibleLaw (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix d) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget d) w := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hPos,hMass,hMean,hPair⟩
    refine ⟨hPos,hMass,?_⟩
    funext c
    rcases c with u|i|⟨i,j⟩
    · simpa [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct] using hMass
    · simpa [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,mul_comm] using hMean i
    · by_cases hij : i=j
      · subst j
        have hSq (x : Fin d → Bool) : (bitSign (x i) : ℝ)*(bitSign (x i) : ℝ)=1 := by
          cases x i <;> norm_num [bitSign]
        simp [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,hSq,hMass]
      · simpa [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,hij,mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_left_comm] using hPair i j hij
  · rintro ⟨hPos,hMass,hMatrix⟩
    refine ⟨hPos,hMass,?_,?_⟩
    · intro i
      have hh := congrFun hMatrix (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))
      simpa [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,mul_comm] using hh
    · intro i j hij
      have hh := congrFun hMatrix (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (i,j)))
      simpa [cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix,cubeProbabilityMomentTarget,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,hij,mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_left_comm] using hh

theorem uniform_cube_vertex_strict_local_collision {d : ℕ}
    (p : (Fin d → Bool) → ℝ) (hp : cubeProbabilityFeasible p)
    (hVertex : p∈Set.extremePoints ℝ {q | cubeProbabilityFeasible q})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hUniform : ∀ x,p x=0 ∨ p x=c) :
    IsLocalMaxOn collision {q | cubeProbabilityFeasible q} p ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀ q,cubeProbabilityFeasible q → q≠p → ‖q-p‖<ε → collision q<collision p := by
  classical
  have hSet : {q : (Fin d → Bool) → ℝ | cubeProbabilityFeasible q}=
      {q | feasibleLaw (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix d) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget d) q} := by
    ext q;exact cube_probability_feasible_iff q
  rw [hSet] at hVertex ⊢
  have hh := uniform_vertex_strict_local_collision (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix d) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget d)
    p ((cube_probability_feasible_iff p).mp hp) hVertex c hc hUniform
  refine ⟨hh.1,?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hStrict⟩ := hh.2
  exact ⟨ε,hε,fun q hq => hStrict q ((cube_probability_feasible_iff q).mp hq)⟩


end

def signRowParity {n : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (i : Fin n) : ℤ := ∏ j, H i j

def signGramError {n : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (i j : Fin n) : ℤ :=
  (∑ k, H i k*H j k)-(if i=j then (n:ℤ) else 0)

theorem sign_gram_parity_pointwise (n : ℕ) (hn : n%4=2)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j=1 ∨ H i j= -1)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    2+2*signRowParity H i*signRowParity H j-(if i=j then 4 else 0)≤signGramError H i j^2 := by
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · subst j
    have hp := prod_sign Finset.univ (H i) (fun j _ => hH i j)
    have hDot : (∑ k, H i k*H i k)=(n:ℤ) := by
      have he (k : Fin n) : H i k*H i k=1 := by rcases hH i k with h|h <;> simp [h]
      simp [he]
    rcases hp with hp|hp <;> simp [signRowParity,signGramError,hDot,hp]
  · have hSign (k : Fin n) : H i k*H j k=1 ∨ H i k*H j k= -1 := by
      rcases hH i k with h|h <;> rcases hH j k with h'|h' <;> simp [h,h']
    have h := residue_two_sign_square_lower Finset.univ (fun k => H i k*H j k)
      (fun k _ => hSign k) (by simpa using hn)
    simpa [signGramError,hij,Finset.prod_mul_distrib,signRowParity,mul_assoc] using h

theorem sign_gram_error_parity_floor (n : ℕ) (hn : n%4=2)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j=1 ∨ H i j= -1) :
    2*(n:ℤ)*((n:ℤ)-2)≤∑ i, ∑ j, signGramError H i j^2 := by
  have hAll := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun j _ => sign_gram_parity_pointwise n hn H hH i j))
  have hConst : (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, (2:ℤ))=2*(n:ℤ)*(n:ℤ) := by simp; ring
  have hCross : (∑ i, ∑ j, 2*signRowParity H i*signRowParity H j)=
      2*(∑ i, signRowParity H i)^2 := by
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul,← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring
  have hDiag : (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, (if i=j then (4:ℤ) else 0))=4*(n:ℤ) := by simp [mul_comm]
  have hSum : (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
      (2+2*signRowParity H i*signRowParity H j-(if i=j then 4 else 0)))=
      2*(n:ℤ)*(n:ℤ)+2*(∑ i, signRowParity H i)^2-4*(n:ℤ) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [hConst,hCross,hDiag]
  rw [hSum] at hAll
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (∑ i, signRowParity H i)]


theorem real_frobenius_norm_sq {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℝ) : ‖M‖^2=∑ i, ∑ j, M i j^2 := by
  rw [Matrix.frobenius_norm_def]
  simp only [Real.rpow_two,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,Real.sq_sqrt]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (M i j)))

theorem real_frobenius_sq_trace {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℝ) : ‖M‖^2=Matrix.trace (M*M.transpose) := by
  rw [real_frobenius_norm_sq]
  simp [Matrix.trace,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.transpose_apply,pow_two]

theorem orthogonal_left_frobenius_invariant {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (U M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hU : U.transpose*U=1) : ‖U*M‖=‖M‖ := by
  have hs : ‖U*M‖^2=‖M‖^2 := by
    rw [real_frobenius_sq_trace,real_frobenius_sq_trace,Matrix.transpose_mul]
    calc
      _=Matrix.trace (U*(M*M.transpose)*U.transpose) := by congr 1; noncomm_ring
      _=Matrix.trace (U.transpose*U*(M*M.transpose)) := Matrix.trace_mul_cycle _ _ _
      _=Matrix.trace (M*M.transpose) := by rw [hU,Matrix.one_mul]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (U*M),norm_nonneg M]

theorem orthogonal_gram_distance_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (U E : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hU : U*U.transpose=1) (hUt : U.transpose*U=1) :
    ‖(U+E)*(U+E).transpose-1‖≤2*‖E‖+‖E‖^2 := by
  have hEq : (U+E)*(U+E).transpose-1=U*E.transpose+E*U.transpose+E*E.transpose := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_add]
    calc
      _=(U*U.transpose-1)+(U*E.transpose+E*U.transpose+E*E.transpose) := by noncomm_ring
      _=_ := by rw [hU,sub_self,zero_add]
  have hA : ‖U*E.transpose‖=‖E‖ := by
    rw [orthogonal_left_frobenius_invariant U E.transpose hUt,Matrix.frobenius_norm_transpose]
  have hB : ‖E*U.transpose‖=‖E‖ := by
    rw [← Matrix.frobenius_norm_transpose (E*U.transpose),Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.transpose_transpose,hA]
  have hC : ‖E*E.transpose‖≤‖E‖^2 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.frobenius_norm_transpose,pow_two] using Matrix.frobenius_norm_mul E E.transpose
  rw [hEq]
  have h := norm_add_le (U*E.transpose+E*U.transpose) (E*E.transpose)
  have h2 := norm_add_le (U*E.transpose) (E*U.transpose)
  rw [hA,hB] at h2
  linarith


noncomputable def parityGapExact (N : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.sqrt (1+Real.sqrt (2*(N-2)/N))-1)^2/N

noncomputable def parityGapSimple (N : ℝ) : ℝ := 2*(N-2)/(9*N^2)

theorem parity_gap_exact_dominates_simple (N : ℝ) (hN : 2≤N) :
    parityGapSimple N≤parityGapExact N := by
  have hNpos : 0<N := by linarith
  have hRatio : 0≤2*(N-2)/N := div_nonneg (by linarith) hNpos.le
  have hRatioUpper : 2*(N-2)/N≤2 := (div_le_iff₀ hNpos).mpr (by linarith)
  let L := Real.sqrt (2*(N-2)/N)
  let a := Real.sqrt (1+L)
  have hL0 : 0≤L := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hL2 : L^2=2*(N-2)/N := Real.sq_sqrt hRatio
  have hLBound : L≤2 := by nlinarith
  have ha0 : 0≤a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha2 : a^2=1+L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have haBound : a≤2 := by nlinarith
  have hIdentity : (a-1)^2*(a+1)^2=L^2 := by
    calc
      _=(a^2-1)^2 := by ring
      _=L^2 := by rw [ha2]; ring
  have hDenBound : (a+1)^2≤9 := by nlinarith
  have hNine : L^2≤9*(a-1)^2 := by
    rw [← hIdentity]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDenBound (sq_nonneg (a-1))]
  have hR : 2*(N-2)≤9*(a-1)^2*N := (div_le_iff₀ hNpos).mp (by rw [← hL2]; exact hNine)
  change 2*(N-2)/(9*N^2)≤(a-1)^2/N
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<9*N^2) hNpos).mpr
  have hMult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR hNpos.le
  nlinarith

theorem parity_gap_from_rounding_distance (N d v : ℝ) (hN : 0<N) (hd : 0≤d)
    (hLower : Real.sqrt (2*(N-2)/N)≤2*d+d^2) (hUpper : d^2≤N*v) :
    parityGapExact N≤v := by
  let L := Real.sqrt (2*(N-2)/N)
  let a := Real.sqrt (1+L)
  have hL : 0≤L := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha : 0≤a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ha2 : a^2=1+L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have ha1 : 1≤a := by nlinarith
  have hdA : a-1≤d := by nlinarith
  have hSq : (a-1)^2≤d^2 := by nlinarith
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hN).mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hSq.trans hUpper


noncomputable def parityRoundSign (x : ℝ) : ℤ := if x<0 then -1 else 1

theorem parity_round_sign_is_sign (x : ℝ) : parityRoundSign x=1 ∨ parityRoundSign x= -1 := by
  unfold parityRoundSign
  split_ifs <;> simp

theorem parity_rounding_square (x a : ℝ) :
    (a*(parityRoundSign x : ℝ)-x)^2=(|x|-a)^2 := by
  by_cases hx : x<0
  · simp [parityRoundSign,hx,abs_of_neg hx] <;> ring
  · simp [parityRoundSign,hx,abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hx)] <;> ring

theorem matching_square_deviation_bound (x a : ℝ) (ha : 0≤a) :
    (|x|-a)^2*a^2≤(x^2-a^2)^2 := by
  have hFactor : a^2≤(|x|+a)^2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
  calc
    _≤(|x|-a)^2*(|x|+a)^2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFactor (sq_nonneg (|x|-a))
    _=(x^2-a^2)^2 := by rw [← sq_abs x]; ring

theorem orthogonal_quartic_variance_identity (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hRows : ∀ i, ∑ j, U i j^2=1) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2)=(∑ i, ∑ j, U i j^4)-1 := by
  have hN : (n:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hMass : (∑ i, ∑ j, U i j^2)=(n:ℝ) := by simp_rw [hRows]; simp
  have he (i j : Fin n) : (U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2=
      U i j^4-(2/(n:ℝ))*U i j^2+(1/(n:ℝ))^2 := by ring
  simp_rw [he,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hMass]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem normalized_sign_rounding_distance (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    let H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := fun i j => parityRoundSign (U i j)
    let C := (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) • H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
    ‖C-U‖^2≤(n:ℝ)*(∑ i, ∑ j, (U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2) := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hRoot : 0<Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN
  have ha : (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ))^2=1/(n:ℝ) := by
    rw [div_pow,one_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  dsimp only
  rw [real_frobenius_norm_sq,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  change ((1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ))*(parityRoundSign (U i j) : ℝ)-U i j)^2≤_
  rw [parity_rounding_square]
  have h := matching_square_deviation_bound (U i j) (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) (by positivity)
  rw [ha] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hN.le
  calc
    _=((|U i j|-1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ))^2*(1/(n:ℝ)))*(n:ℝ) := by field_simp
    _≤(U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2*(n:ℝ) := hm
    _=(n:ℝ)*(U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2 := by ring


theorem real_sign_gram_error_floor (n : ℕ) (hn : n%4=2)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j=1 ∨ H i j= -1) :
    2*(n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-2)≤
      ‖H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)*(H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).transpose-
        (n:ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)‖^2 := by
  have h := sign_gram_error_parity_floor n hn H hH
  simp only [signGramError] at h
  rw [real_frobenius_norm_sq]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.transpose_apply,Matrix.map_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Matrix.one_apply,mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero]
  change 2*(n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-2)≤∑ i, ∑ j,
    ((∑ k, (H i k : ℝ)*(H j k : ℝ))-(if i=j then (n:ℝ) else 0))^2
  exact_mod_cast h

theorem normalized_sign_gram_error_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : n%4=2)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hH : ∀ i j, H i j=1 ∨ H i j= -1) :
    let C := (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) • H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
    Real.sqrt (2*((n:ℝ)-2)/(n:ℝ))≤‖C*C.transpose-1‖ := by
  have hnPos : 0<n := by omega
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hnPos
  have hNne : (n:ℝ)≠0 := hN.ne'
  have ha : (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ))^2=1/(n:ℝ) := by
    rw [div_pow,one_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  let M := H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
  let C := (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) • M
  have hEq : C*C.transpose-1=(1/(n:ℝ)) • (M*M.transpose-(n:ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [C]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,smul_smul,← pow_two,ha]
    rw [smul_sub,smul_smul,one_div_mul_cancel hNne,one_smul]
  have hFloor := real_sign_gram_error_floor n hn H hH
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFloor (sq_nonneg (1/(n:ℝ)))
  have hCoeff : (1/(n:ℝ))^2*(2*(n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)-2))=2*((n:ℝ)-2)/(n:ℝ) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hCoeff] at hm
  have hSq : 2*((n:ℝ)-2)/(n:ℝ)≤‖C*C.transpose-1‖^2 := by
    rw [hEq,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hN),mul_pow]
    exact hm
  exact (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr ⟨norm_nonneg _,hSq⟩

theorem elementary_orthogonal_parity_gap (n : ℕ) (hn : n%4=2)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hU : U*U.transpose=1) (hUt : U.transpose*U=1) :
    parityGapExact (n:ℝ)≤(∑ i, ∑ j, U i j^4)-1 ∧
    parityGapSimple (n:ℝ)≤parityGapExact (n:ℝ) ∧
    ‖Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))‖^2=
      (∑ i, ∑ j, U i j^4)-1 := by
  have hn2 : 2≤n := by omega
  have hnPos : 0<n := by omega
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hnPos
  have hRows (i : Fin n) : ∑ j, U i j^2=1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => M i i) hU
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.transpose_apply,pow_two] using h
  have hVariance := orthogonal_quartic_variance_identity n hnPos U hRows
  let H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := fun i j => parityRoundSign (U i j)
  let C := (1/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) • H.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
  have hH (i j : Fin n) : H i j=1 ∨ H i j= -1 := parity_round_sign_is_sign _
  have hLower := normalized_sign_gram_error_lower n hn H hH
  have hUpper := orthogonal_gram_distance_bound U (C-U) hU hUt
  have hC : U+(C-U)=C := by abel
  rw [hC] at hUpper
  have hDist : ‖C-U‖^2≤(n:ℝ)*((∑ i, ∑ j, U i j^4)-1) := by
    have h := normalized_sign_rounding_distance n hnPos U
    rw [hVariance] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨parity_gap_from_rounding_distance (n:ℝ) ‖C-U‖ _ hN (norm_nonneg _) (hLower.trans hUpper) hDist,
    parity_gap_exact_dominates_simple (n:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hn2),?_⟩
  calc
    _=(∑ i, ∑ j, (U i j^2-1/(n:ℝ))^2) := real_frobenius_norm_sq _
    _=_ := hVariance
